thread:
erin_sales: Hey team — ready to start cleanup for the Acme evaluation environment? Need to shut down hosted keys, Dedicated pool and VPC peering by Friday.
sam_eng: I can handle API key invalidation. Which keys belong to the eval?
erin_sales: Provided list in the trial spreadsheet: api_key_eval_acme_01, api_key_eval_acme_02. Also a read-only ingest key.
maria_sre: Reminder: we need a snapshot of logs and a retention decision before deletion. Legal might ask for 90d archive.
claudia_legal: 90 days archive is fine. Export logs to the secure bucket and mark them "legal-hold". Don't delete until we confirm.
sam_eng: Plan: 1) revoke keys 2) rotate ingress tokens for pools 3) deprovision dedicated pool 4) remove VPC peering
kevin_soleng: For Dedicated pool teardown: drain traffic, snapshot model cache, then deallocate. I can run:
```
redwoodctl pool drain --pool acme-trial-01
redwoodctl pool snapshot-cache --pool acme-trial-01 --out s3://redwood-exports/acme-cache-183456
redwoodctl pool delete --pool acme-trial-01
```
sam_eng: For Hosted API keys:
```
redwoodctl keys list --owner acme@example.com
redwoodctl keys revoke api_key_eval_acme_01
redwoodctl keys revoke api_key_eval_acme_02
```
erin_sales: Also update billing: stop trial metering on 2028-05-12 — confirm with finance.
maria_sre: VPC peering: schedule a 10-min window, verify there are no active tunnels. Command:
```
redwoodctl vpc list-peers --customer acme
redwoodctl vpc delete-peer --peer-id peer-abc123
```
deploy-bot: Automated backup completed: s3://redwood-exports/acme-logs-183456 (md5: 9a3f...)
claudia_legal: Confirmed receipt of backup link. We'll hold for 90 days and then instruct deletion.
sam_eng: KV cache scrub: run kvtool scrub --prefix acme/ --dry-run then actual. Also clear prefix cache on runtime nodes.
kevin_soleng: I've scheduled pool drain for 2028-05-11 22:00 UTC. Will update when deleted.
erin_sales: Who will notify the customer that credentials revoked and resources gone?
sam_eng: I'll send a wrap email with checklist. Draft below:
"Hi ACME — we've revoked evaluation keys (api_key_eval_*), deallocated dedicated pool acme-trial-01, and removed VPC peering. Logs exported to secure bucket and retained per agreement. Please reply if you need any artifacts."
erin_sales: Perfect. Add link to exported logs and list of artifacts: cache snapshot, logs, billing stop date.
claudia_legal: Approve wording. Please include a ticket ID and contact for data requests.
erin_sales: Ticket created: #54321. I'll send after deploy-bot confirms deletion.
deploy-bot: Pool deletion completed: acme-trial-01 at 2028-05-11T22:12:45Z
sam_eng: Keys revoked, KV scrub started (running). Notifying customer now.
erin_sales: Sent to ACME: https://mail.internal/msg/54321
maria_sre: KV scrub finished. No remaining prefixes. Runtime caches cleared.
sam_eng: Final checklist — billing stopped, keys revoked, pool deleted, VPC removed, logs archived, legal hold set.
erin_sales: Great — marking POC environment as decommissioned. Closing internal ticket #54321. :white_check_mark:
claudia_legal: Thanks all — keep the export until 2098-08-01 per retention metadata (90d) then auto-delete unless hold extended.
kevin_soleng: Noted. Archiving runbook for future reference: /runbooks/poc-decomm.md
erin_sales: Thread closed unless any objections.
